entries.situation: The matching key hangs in the exposed, unlatched cabinet; it was not visible from the doorway.
entries.adjudication: The key opens D1 without a check; its unlock DC remains available.

entries.situation: The shelf's rear-right upright turns on a floor pivot. A crate supports its broken front-left foot; a clipped wire links its upper-left corner to the wall.
entries.adjudication: Support the broken corner with one person or a lever, unclip the wire, pull out the crate, then rotate the shelf 90 degrees clockwise on its rear-right floor pivot; no check. Pulling the crate first drops the shelf across the cabinet and yanks the wire. Two people or a lever can lift and reset it without a check; record one bell ring.

player_choices.action: Support, unclip, remove crate, rotate shelf
player_choices.outcome: Expose the cabinet without ringing the bell.
Shelf blocks the cabinet and rings the bell; lift and reset it to retry.

entries.name: Three-Button Vault Lock
entries.situation: In the wall panel immediately left of the vault door, each pressed button latches down and advances a three-step drum. The correct third press retracts the vault bolt; a wrong third press trips the bell and resets the drum.
entries.solution: Press doorway, shelves, chest—the order shown at the Entry and stated on F1.
entries.adjudication: No check. Any trigger swings the hammer: its upper arm rings the bell, its lower arm flips the full ink cup, and a clockwork bolt locks the buttons for 10 minutes. Wipe away the first spill; later rings find the cup empty. Every ring restarts the lockout. No guard or creature responds; ink and lockout are the only consequences.

player_choices.outcome: The vault door unlocks and opens.
Reset buttons, ring bell, and start a 10-minute lockout.
Reveal the symbols; retry after 10 minutes.

entries.situation: F1 reads, 'Press where a record ENTERS, is SORTED, then is STORED.' Doorway, shelves, and chest symbols sit below those verbs.
entries.adjudication: No check. A service diagram traces three covered conduits to the shared bell trip lever: Annex shelf, concealed threshold plate T1, and button drum. Tracing it automatically identifies the threshold plate; disabling its coupling still requires T1's DC 13 check.

player_choices.outcome: Identify all three bell triggers and automatically detect T1's concealed threshold plate.

entries.situation: Solving the hall lock released the cradle's hidden catch; its clear panel now opens by hand.
entries.adjudication: No check. Record the choice as prepared, not automatically canonical.

player_choices.outcome: Gain evidence but do not complete retrieval.

room_narratives.read_aloud: Dry steps end at a wall diagram. Three arrow-linked pictures show an exterior doorway, records being sorted onto shelves, and a record locked in a chest.
sensory_details: The three pictures are clean and easy to see.

room_narratives.read_aloud: Cabinets form narrow aisles. Water laps through the north doorway. The locked hall door bears a brass emblem of three wavy lines.
A tall shelf stands one pace in front of a wave-marked wall cabinet. Its broken front-left foot rests on a waterlogged crate; a brass wire clips to its upper-left corner and enters the wall.
sensory_details: The shelf's rear-right upright sits on a round floor pivot.
The closed cabinet's contents cannot be seen.

room_narratives.read_aloud: Three labeled buttons fill a wall panel immediately left of the vault door. Above them, a two-armed hammer rests against a brass bell, with its lower arm beneath a full ink cup. Three wire ends emerge from covered conduits and join one trip lever.
sensory_details: The button symbols are visible from the doorway.
The covered conduits hide where the three wires begin.

room_narratives.read_aloud: A clear-panelled cradle holds the Synthetic Objective. From the doorway, the panel looks seamless against its frame.
sensory_details: The clear panel sits flush with the cradle frame.
